mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM `user_role` ur INNER JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN `role_permission` rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rp.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN `permission` p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_delete = 0 WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.status = 1 AND ur.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `user_role` ur INNER JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN `role_permission` rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rp.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN `permission` p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_delete = 0 WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.status = 1 AND ur.is_delete = 0 AND p.code = #{permissionCode}
